تتقاووا (form VI)
# تَتَقَاوَوْا (tataqāwaw) /ta.ta.qaː.waw/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَقَاوَى (taqāwā)
# تُتَقَاوَوْا (tutaqāwaw) /tu.ta.qaː.waw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَقَاوَى (taqāwā)
